messages.subject: Project Atlas - SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Please find our first draft of the share purchase agreement for Project Atlas. It reflects the agreed heads of terms - GBP 54.5m equity value, GBP 50m completion cash, GBP 2.5m retention (18 months) and up to GBP 2m deferred. Warranties and tax covenant from the three Warrantors, with a full warranty schedule. We have proposed a warranty cap at the full consideration and a 24-month general claims period as a starting position; happy to discuss.

Look forward to your mark-up.

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
